mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuation multiples and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises 0.5pp+ over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated year-over-year CPI growth above 3.5% indicates persistent inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes that compress equity earnings multiples and generate negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12m % change exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% and CPIAUCSL 12m % change above 3.5% signal aggressive monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, causing equity market sell-offs that produce negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL 12m % change > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts below 1450 thousand units indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering equity market corrections that produce negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1450.0.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, strong GDP growth above 1.5% annually signals sustained economic momentum that supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of instances during late-cycle expansion with GDPC1 growth >1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightening with unemployment below 3.5% indicates strong economic conditions that boost corporate earnings and equity prices, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.5 index points indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profitability, which generates negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.5.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real consumer spending below 680,000 million dollars indicates weakening household demand, leading to equity market declines that produce negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances when RSAFS falls below 680000.0.
